Assume the mass of the neutron to be equal to that of H atom. Use the energy of the n th state for H atom as E1 = −13.6 eV; E2 = −3.4 eV; E3 = −1.5 eV. (1) The half life of radionuclide A is greater than that of B . (2) At t = 60 min, number of atoms in sample of material A is greater than that of sample B . (3) The two samples will never have the same decay rate simultaneously. (4) After certain time, the two samples will have the same decay rate simultaneously for an instant.
